newsitem.title: USA: AMERICAN FOOTBALL-N. CAROLINA BEATS W. VIRGINIA IN GATOR BOWL.
newsitem.headline: AMERICAN FOOTBALL-N. CAROLINA BEATS W. VIRGINIA IN GATOR BOWL.

text.p: Oscar Davenport threw for one touchdown and ran for another in a 17-point second quarter to spark 11th-ranked North Carolina to a 20-13 victory over 25th-ranked West Virginia in the Gator Bowl on Wednesday.

Davenport, a sophomore making his first start in place of the injured Chris Keldorf, threw an 18-yard touchdown pass to Octavus Barnes 1:55 into the second quarter to open the scoring and scored on a five-yard run with 1:15 left in the period as the Tar Heels took a 17-3 halftime lead.
The Mountaineers cut the deficit to 17-10 early in the third quarter on a 34-yard pass from Chad Johnston to David Saunders, who caught nine passes for 130 yards.
A 20-yard field goal by Josh McGee late in the third quarter increased the lead to 20-10. A 47-yard field goal by Jay Taylor with 8:18 left in the fourth quarter cut the lead to 20-13.
West Virginia drove to the Tar Heels 25 with 1:53 remaining before turning the ball over on downs as a short fourth-down pass by Johnston fell incomplete.
